name: Christina Bohannan
desc: American attorney, legal scholar, engineer, and politician
summary:
Christina Bohannan (born July 2, 1971) is an American politician and law professor who is the representative-elect for Iowa's 1st congressional district in the United States House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, she served from 2021 to 2023 as the Iowa state representative for the 85th House district, having been elected in 2020 to succeed Vicki Lensing.
Bohannan was the unsuccessful Democratic nominee for Iowa's 1st congressional district in 2022 and 2024, losing to Republican incumbent Mariannette Miller-Meeks.
